notes: You can now choose which 60 seconds you get free. Trim the clip to the part you want and export it with Upscale on export, and that part comes out whole. The upgrade window and the editor's export hint now say so. Free exports of upscaling, restoring and colour work still stop at 60 seconds; Convert, Mute, Compress, Loop and the other tools run at full length, all with the small “Made with Crisp” mark. Pro, $129 once, removes the limit and the mark.
